definitions.gloss: here and there; everywhere; all over the place
definitions.explanation: In various places throughout an area, implying wide distribution. Slightly literary or elevated in register.

examples.japanese: ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧そこかしこ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{咲|さ}いている→咲く：08150_saku⟧。
examples.english: Cherry blossoms are blooming here and there.

examples.japanese: ⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧そこかしこ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are cafes all over the town.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、そこかしこ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{折|お}れた→折れる：01266_oreru⟧⟦{枝|えだ}→枝：02181_eda⟧や⟦{散|ち}らばった→散らばる：12713_chirabaru⟧⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}られた→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: After the typhoon, broken branches and scattered debris could be seen everywhere.

notes:
A slightly literary adverb meaning "here and there" or "all over." Composed of ⟦そこ→そこ：00991_soko⟧ (there) + かしこ (over there), combining two demonstratives to express the idea of multiple scattered locations. More evocative and descriptive than ⟦あちこち→あちこち：01687_achikochi⟧.

USAGE:
Often used in written prose and descriptive passages. Can follow a noun with the particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (そこかしこ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧) to indicate location.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦あちこち→あちこち：01687_achikochi⟧: here and there — the most common everyday equivalent; neutral register
- ⟦あちらこちら→あちらこちら：25969_achirakochira⟧: here and there — polite form of ⟦あちこち→あちこち：01687_achikochi⟧
- {至|いた}るところ: everywhere — emphasizes completeness of distribution; slightly formal
- ⟦{方々|ほうぼう}→方々：00116_houbou⟧: all around, in many places — implies searching or moving around
